messages.subject: Re: How to interpret the M2 fit statistic?
parts:
M2 is a chi-squared type of statistics based on whether the sample data matches the theoretical population generating model implied by what was fitted. Roughly the same interpretation as what the chi-squared statistics is in the SEM literature. Regarding the p-value, you can extract that out of the object itself using the $ operator to obtain a non-rounded version.

Phil
